We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no molecule given. Possibly the sample at hand is implicit? The tools can give NMR spectra, but we need aromatic carbon count. Could retrieve carbon shifts ranges? Not helpful. Maybe the system expects we use carbon_nmr_spectra to get spectrum and infer number of aromatic carbons from number of aromatic carbon signals. But we don't know which signals are aromatic. Could use retrieve_aromatic_protons_shifts? Not.

We need the molecule context. Perhaps the environment has a sample loaded. Use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR. Then count aromatic carbon peaks (around 120-150 ppm). Let's call tool.
